key_insight: Local token uncertainty in discrete flow matching is strongly tied to how much nearby context is available, so weighting the process by context makes generation and training easier.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a low-overhead way to improve discrete generative models, reducing perplexity and matching a strong semi-autoregressive baseline while preserving arbitrary-order generation.
method: Modify the CTMC sampler to incorporate local context density.
Use a context-weighted sampler to prioritize better-conditioned tokens during generation.
Apply a scaled cross-entropy loss to reweight training signals from high- vs. low-uncertainty tokens.
evidence_signal: On OpenWebText, the scaled loss reduced generative perplexity by up to 63%, and the approach matched a strong semi-autoregressive block diffusion baseline in quality.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how context density is estimated and tuned, so the weighting scheme could be sensitive to implementation details or dataset structure.
